shortDescription: Create, modify, or delete a firmware catalog on OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: catalog_description
options.description: Description for the catalog.

options.name: catalog_id
options.description: ID of the catalog. This option is mutually exclusive with I(catalog_name). Provide the list of firmware catalog IDs that are supported when I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: catalog_name
options.description: Name of the firmware catalog to be created. This option is mutually exclusive with I(catalog_id). Provide the list of firmware catalog names that are supported when I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: check_certificate
options.description: The certificate warnings are ignored when I(repository_type) is HTTPS. If C(true). If not, certificate warnings are not ignored.

options.name: file_name
options.description: Catalog file name associated with the I(source_path). This option is ignored when I(repository_type) is C(DELL_ONLINE).

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular IP address or hostname.

options.name: job_wait
options.description: Provides the option to wait for job completion. This option is applicable when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: job_wait_timeout
options.description: The maximum wait time of I(job_wait) in seconds. The job is tracked only for this duration. This option is applicable when I(job_wait) is C(true).

options.name: new_catalog_name
options.description: New name of the firmware catalog.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: port
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular HTTPS port.

options.name: repository_domain
options.description: Domain name of the repository. This option is ignored when I(repository_type) is C(DELL_ONLINE).

options.name: repository_password
options.description: Password to access the repository. This option is mandatory when I(repository_type) is CIFS. This option is ignored when I(repository_type) is C(DELL_ONLINE). C(NOTE) The module always reports the changed status, when this is provided.

options.name: repository_type
options.description: Type of repository. The supported types are NFS, CIFS, HTTP, HTTPS,and DELL_ONLINE.

options.name: repository_username
options.description: User name of the repository where the catalog is stored. This option is mandatory when I(repository_type) is CIFS. This option is ignored when I(repository_type) is C(DELL_ONLINE).

options.name: source
options.description: The IP address of the system where the firmware catalog is stored on the local network. By default, this option is set to downloads.dell.com when I(repository_type) is C(DELL_ONLINE).

options.name: source_path
options.description: Specify the complete path of the catalog file location without the file name. This is option ignored when I(repository_type) is C(DELL_ONLINE).

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) creates or modifies a catalog. C(absent) deletes an existing catalog.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
